During this year and a half, have you also experienced significant periods where your mood was extremely high or low, such as feeling severely depressed or unusually energetic and impulsive?

Yes, for about eight months now, I've had periods where I feel incredibly high and overflowing with physical and mental energy. I don't ever really feel depressed or low, but instead my mood shifts between being extremely energetic and getting very irritable.
Are there times when you experience these jumbled thoughts and disorganized speech even when your mood is stable and you are not feeling particularly high or irritable?

No, the jumbled thoughts and rambling only seem to happen when my mood is really high or when I'm feeling super irritable and energetic. When my mood is stable, my thoughts clear up and my speech doesn't get disorganized like that at all. It really only happens during those intense, high-energy times.
